name: Dayton Foundation: Greater Dayton Conservation Fund grants

summary: Grants to nonprofit organisations protecting the natural environment of the Great Miami and Little Miami River watersheds in southwest Ohio, through restoration, education and science.

status.quote: Applications must be submitted by August 7, 2026.
